title: The Cube Designer agent runs on ai.provider=openai/ollama, mapped to the same text + tool_use contract

criteria.given: saiku.ai.ask.provider is openai or ollama (no API key needed for ollama)
criteria.then: CubeDesignerAiService sends an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions request carrying the designer's tools, and maps the model's tool_calls back to the text + tool_use content blocks the client already renders (unit-tested against a scripted HttpClient)

criteria.given: the next turn sends the assistant's tool_use back with its tool_result
criteria.then: the OpenAI request translates it to a role:"tool" message with the same tool_call_id (unit-tested)
the Anthropic Messages transport is unchanged: same request builder, same x-api-key/anthropic-version headers, same verbatim content[] response, existing tests untouched

criteria.given: the OpenAI-compatible upstream misbehaves (malformed tool_calls, bad arguments JSON, HTTP errors, timeouts)
criteria.then: the turn throws a clear IOException (502) naming the problem - never a 500 stack trace - with unit tests for each case

criteria.given: no usable provider is configured (noop, or a hosted provider with no key)
criteria.then: the designer /turn endpoint returns 503 with an AI upstream not configured message
it reports the Cube Designer's provider and model next to the ask and schemaGen stacks (tested)
they explain that the Cube Designer follows saiku.ai.ask.provider and how to run it against Ollama
